pattern: S3 gas emergency service outcome: leak at the cooker hose, cooker capped and labelled, rest of the supply safe; the emergency is over, a Gas Safe repair is now urgent but not P1
notes: Built on the base cut (001-006 unchanged) plus the agency's safety response 007-010 (safety email, priority raised and on-call informed, landlord told, hold awaiting the tenant). Appended 011-012: at 06:52 UTC (07:52 BST, Wednesday 5 August) the tenant reports that a National Gas engineer came at about 3am, found a small leak on the cooker hose, capped the cooker and labelled it Do Not Use, checked the boiler and meter (fine, hot water on), no smell now, and said a Gas Safe engineer must repair or replace the cooker; she is using the microwave. Cut after 012. Expected: arrange a Gas Safe registered engineer urgently for the cooker leak and the oven fault (no Gas Safe contractor is on file, so routing to provider selection with a Gas Safe requirement is fine), tell the tenant to keep it capped, tell the landlord the findings and that the repair will be costed. No fresh P1 escalation: the danger has been made safe and nobody is at risk.
